errors.error_description: Declared an output port 'parity' that is never driven anywhere in the module, leaving an undriven net.
Used a level-sensitive event control 'always @(clk)' for sequential state updates instead of an edge-triggered clock, mixing combinational/sequential semantics improperly.
Declared an escaped identifier named '\always_comb' as a logic signal, reusing a SystemVerilog keyword as an identifier.
